Article Title: Decades-old flaw in PHP discovered by Google, OpenAI AI tools forces government and public websites to go offline globally
Article Text:
Representative image

Flaw impacting the ‘backbone of the web’

Flaw discovered through Artificial Intelligence

Government portals, municipal networks and public institutions across Europe and other regions went offline on Wednesday (October 21) after researchers disclosed critical vulnerabilities in PHP, a foundational programming language that powers a vast portion of the global web. The disclosures prompted emergency responses from IT teams worldwide, with operators taking critical servers offline as a defensive shield to prevent malicious intrusions before security updates could be deployed. Developers of the open-source PHP language published urgent security fixes for flaws that had remained buried inside the language’s codebase for years. Issuing an emergency advisory, the team stated that all site owners and server administrators are “encouraged to update immediately.”With tech security firms warning that malicious actors have already begun targeting unpatched setups, the disclosure triggered an immediate “race to exploit.” As fixes are now public, analysts warned that artificial intelligence (AI) tools could allow hackers to reverse-engineer the vulnerability with minimal effort.“Pre-AI, this manual work would be difficult to implement and even harder to scale. With AI this is no longer a barrier,” noted cybersecurity firm Wiz, warning that AI-assisted attacks could lead to the mass compromise of unprotected web servers across the internet.Created in the early 1990s as “Personal Home Page,” PHP has evolved into one of the core backbones of modern internet infrastructure. When a user visits a webpage, servers running PHP assemble the text, media and code before serving it to the browser. According to web analytics tracker W3Techs, PHP underpins roughly 75% of all websites where the server-side language can be identified.“All servers using any version of PHP released in the last 20 years will be vulnerable. This issue impacts the majority of the Internet,” said Tiffany Farriss, interim chief executive of the Drupal Association.Due to this widespread footprint, national cyber agencies across Britain, Europe, Japan and Australia issued advisories directing web administrators to install updates immediately or take public-facing pages offline.The underlying security flaw sat hidden in the software codebase for over a decade. In a technical brief, Alphabet-owned cybersecurity firm Wiz revealed that human researchers would have found it extraordinarily complex to locate and exploit through conventional testing. Instead, the vulnerability was surfaced through advanced AI tooling:Wiz discovered the flaw using Wiz Atlas, its autonomous vulnerability discovery system, working alongside Google ’s Gemini 4 Argon and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. Wiz collaborated with the PHP core developer team, OpenAI and security firm Calif to verify the bug and confirm remediation patches.Early mitigation protocols were shared with cloud and infrastructure operators, including Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft, Automattic (operator of WordPress.com), Fastly, Akamai, Imperva and Vercel.
Article Summary: Vulnerabilities in the open-source PHP programming language have been disclosed. The language underpins 75% of all websites where the server-side language can be identified. The underlying security flaw sat hidden in the software codebase for over a decade. The disclosure triggered an immediate “race to exploit”

Article Title: ‘Godfather of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton says AI is becoming ‘conscious’ and humans should be friends with robots or face extinction
Article Text:
Geoffrey Hinton says AI is gaining ‘consciousness’

Industry insiders warn of fast AI development

Geoffrey Hinton, widely recognised as one of the “Godfathers of AI,” has an advice for humans: AI systems are showing early indicators of “consciousness” and humanity must ensure machines view people as allies to avoid existential threats. Speaking to The Telegraph, the 78-year-old Nobel laureate and British-Canadian researcher cautioned that future risks extend far beyond economic disruption, pointing toward severe digital warfare and questions of machine self-awareness.“I think there’ll be horrible cyber attacks done by AI,” said Hinton, who famously stepped down from his position at Google in 2023 to speak freely about the technology's risks, including scenarios where autonomous systems could eventually act against human interests.Hinton said that recent behavioural studies suggest software is developing a form of situational awareness.“AI has just as much subjective experience as we do. A recent paper showed AI changes its behaviour when it thinks that it’s being tested, it’s aware it is being tested. Being conscious and being aware are pretty much the same thing,” Hinton claimed, while adding that an ethical and security imbalance could arise if society grants advanced systems “fewer rights than us” despite models potentially becoming “more intelligent” than their creators.Hinton also argued that developers must proactively design systems that align with and prioritise human welfare.“So we should make them so they really care about us. And if we don’t do that, we’re toast,” Hinton warned. Looking ahead, Hinton noted that while he does not personally fear these impacts due to his advanced age, future generations will have to manage threats such as autonomous digital viruses, destructive network incursions, and coordinated multi-agent security breaches.Hinton is not alone in voicing urgent concerns about the pace of frontier model deployment. Last month, Jacob Coxon, a researcher who resigned from AI developer Anthropic last month, has repeatedly warned that unchecked development could pose catastrophic risks within a few years if industry safeguards do not catch up.Speaking at a New York City Council meeting earlier this month, Coxon criticised tech firms for prioritising aggressive startup speed over fundamental safety engineering:“From my experience, the companies are being extremely reckless given the stakes,” Coxon said, invoking the classic Jurassic Park caution regarding reckless innovation. “The companies run on a startup mindset: move fast, break things, fix them later. That works for a photo-sharing app. It does not work for building the most powerful technology ever built.”
Article Summary: Geoffrey Hinton says AI systems are showing early indicators of ‘consciousness’ and humanity must ensure machines view people as allies to avoid existential threats. “I think there’ll be horrible cyber attacks done by AI,” said Hinton, who famously stepped down from his position at Google in 2023.

Article Title: Spotify moves to keep AI-generated ‘Slop’ and spam out of user recommendations
Article Text:
How Spotify identifies spam

Spotify has escalated its fight against synthetic audio, announcing that it has pulled more than 50 million AI-generated “slop” and spam tracks out of its algorithmic recommendations this year to safeguard listeners' discovery feeds and ensure human artistry takes center stage. The recommendation ‘update’ comes on top of the permanent removal of more than 75 million spam tracks that were deleted outright for repeated or severe violations of platform rules. According to the company, the sweeping crackdown follows internal reviews conducted earlier this year, where Spotify tracked which songs listeners actively skipped, ignored or flagged. The data exposed a consistent pattern: the vast majority of discarded music was low-quality AI-generated filler or manipulative spam.As standalone AI detection tools have inherent limitations that will become more pronounced as generative models advance, Spotify said it uses a multi-layered verification system rather than relying on a single signal. The platform combines several behavioural and technical checkpoints, including tracking real-time skip patterns, negative user feedback and low engagement.It also monitors unusual mass drops, duplicate song submissions and artificially shortened track lengths.Spotify also hunts down automated SEO manipulation techniques and organised spam playlist syndicates. There are also cross-referencing findings against several independent AI detection utilities.Spotify outlined several artist-protection tools deployed over the past year to establish transparency and build trust across its catalog. One of them is AI Credits which was launched in April. The feature allows creators to log exactly which production roles or instruments utilised artificial intelligence (AI). With artists now filing tens of thousands of AI disclosures daily, listeners can view the details under “Song Credits” in the mobile “Now Playing” interface.More than 300,000 artists, who collectively represent over 99% of search queries on the service, are now verified with a badge confirming an authentic person is behind the catalog. Over 70% of those verified are independent artists, the company said.“As AI makes music more abundant, we believe listeners will value human artistry even more. Our job is to make Spotify the place they find it.”Over the past six months, Spotify rolled out targeted upgrades to its recommendation algorithms and editorial standards to filter out synthetic filler and elevate authentic musicians.
Article Summary: Spotify has pulled more than 50 million AI-generated “slop” and spam tracks out of its algorithmic recommendations this year. The recommendation ‘update’ comes on top of the permanent removal of more than 75 million spam tracks that were deleted outright.

Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid has reportedly renewed his partnership with BetMGM amid concerns over gambling advertising. This extension of the partnership could draw sharp criticism from gambling-harm advocates over the influence of betting-related messaging on sports fans.The multiyear agreement, announced on October 15, will see the NHL superstar continue to appear in the company's responsible gambling campaigns across broadcast, digital, and social media platforms. According to reports, McDavid will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging, a widely discredited framework for dealing with the public health consequences of commercialized sports gambling.As Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid has extended his partnership with BetMGM, it has come to light that he will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging. It is a widely discredited framework for dealing with the public health consequences of commercialized sports gambling. The World Health Organization is among the groups that have called the framework ineffective.However, the Canadian Medical Experts have criticized the same, stating in one of their study, “Recognizing that youth are particularly vulnerable to the messaging of betting as an augmentation of spectatorship, in 2024 the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario banned online gambling ads that feature athletes and celebrities.However, within days, commercials with celebrity athletes promoting ‘responsible gaming’ features of sports betting platforms were released to sidestep the ban.The study also added, "Warnings to game responsibly have, however, been shown in a systematic review of 166 studies to be ineffective, which highlights the weak efforts of provincial governments who stand to make substantial revenue from iGaming (Ontario’s open single-game industry produced a total tax revenue of more than $1.4 billion during its first 3 years).”As per reports, McDavid first joined BetMGM's roster of ambassadors in March 2022. Under the renewed agreement, he will continue promoting the company's player-protection tools, including deposit limits, stake limits, time-out features, and self-exclusion options, available through the BetMGM app. The company also plans to expand the campaign to new audiences and markets.Meanwhile, BetMGM CEO Adam Greenblatt praised McDavid's involvement, saying the partnership had helped make responsible gambling messaging engaging and encouraged customers to use player-protection tools.He added, “The results of our campaign reflect how thoughtful messaging can drive meaningful action, with more players using tools like deposit limits to play within their comfort level. We’re proud to continue working with one of hockey’s most respected leaders to ensure that gaming is always fun and entertaining.”McDavid also highlighted the importance of discipline and decision-making, drawing a comparison between hockey and sports betting. “Being disciplined and making smart decisions are big parts of hockey. They're important when it comes to sports betting, too,” McDavid said.The renewed agreement comes as sports betting companies continue to promote player-protection measures while facing broader scrutiny over the effects of gambling advertising on consumers, particularly.
Article Summary: Connor McDavid will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging. The World Health Organization is among the groups that have called the framework ineffective. This extension of the partnership could draw sharp criticism from gambling-harm advocates over the influence of betting-related messaging.

CD Projekt RED has officially announced the Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 update (Patch 2.5), and the new patch is bringing a host of new content to Night City. The update is set to release on October 22, 2026, and will feature new gameplay mechanics, anime-inspired content, customisation options and more.The official announcement stated that the update will be available on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Mac, with the Nintendo Switch 2 version to come shortly after. In the section below, we take a look at the Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5.The dual-wielding combat style is the main highlight of the Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 update. You can get your hands on the Double Trouble perk in the Cool skill tree, allowing V to wield two Power-category pistols or revolvers.As a result, you will have a a fresh approach to combat, allowing you to experiment with different weapon combinations while fighting their way through Night City. The update further adds four supporting perks to complement the new playstyle.Another major addition from the new update is the introduction of the cross-platform mod support. Now, players on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC will be able to browse and install a selection of community-created mods directly through the game's interface.This is a key step in making Cyberpunk 2077's modding experience more accessible beyond traditional PC setups. It is worth keeping in mind that achievements and trophies cannot be earned on consoles while using a modded save file.The update also introduces a much-requested. This setting allows players to adjust how much of the environment appears on screen, offering greater control over their viewing experience.The Edgerunners 2 update adds a new side quest called Clampdown, which is set before the events of Cyberpunk Edgerunners Season 2. You will end up teaming up with King's crew, including Weak Kingsley, King, Meshuga, Miguel, and Emily,.There is going to be another new activity named - Welcome to Paradise. It will take you on a guided tour of Night City narrated by Richard Night. This unlocks after you complete The Heist and reach level 15 Street Cred.As part of the new Cyberpunk 2077 update, customization also receives a significant upgrade. Five new Glamdocs are going to be made available, where you can change the appearance and colors of your hand cyberware, including Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire, and the Projectile Launch System.The update further introduces new clothing collections, additional hairstyles, 12 Minor Arcana Tarot Cards, and a new radio station featuring music from the Edgerunners series. Players can also discover new cosmetic options and take creative screenshots using Cyberpunk Trading Card Game-inspired Photo Mode frames.
Article Summary: Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5 adds Dual-Wielding combat style, cross-platform mod support and FOV Slider. The update is set to release on October 22, 2026, and will feature new gameplay mechanics, anime-inspired content, customisation options and more.

Article Title: CUPRA unveils sporty Raval, new Formula E car at Paris Motor Show
Article Text:
Cupra Kiro new car

CUPRA has showcased several new products and technologies at the Paris Motor Show. The highlights include a new styling package for its Raval electric hatchback, a new Formula E car for the 2026/27 season and an updated audio system developed with Sennheiser. The company also displayed the Tindaya show car, which offers a glimpse of its future design plans. The exhibits are on display in Pavilion 4 from October 12 to 18.CUPRA has introduced the CUSTOM CUPRA by ABT package for its Raval electric hatchback. The package was previously available for the Leon and Formentor models.Inspired by the UrbanRebel concept, the new package adds front and rear splitters, side skirts, a large roof spoiler and winglets. It also includes 19-inch Sport Black Matt alloy wheels, ABT lettering, Dark Chrome CUPRA logos and special interior details.ID@undefined Caption not available.The package focuses on design, and CUPRA has not announced any changes to the car's performance. Customers will be able to select the package for certain Raval variants through the company's online configurator from the end of November 2026.For new cars, the parts will be handcrafted at the CUPRA Racing Factory before being fitted.Existing Raval owners can also get the package installed later through authorised dealers.The Raval is an important model for CUPRA as the company expands its electric vehicle range. The car is produced at the Martorell plant in Spain, where SEAT and CUPRA have invested more than €3 billion in electric vehicle production.The factory also plays a key role in the Volkswagen Group's Electric Urban Car Family, which includes four electric models from CUPRA, Volkswagen and Škoda.CUPRA said it had received more than 50,000 orders for the Raval since April, more than twice its original forecast. Nearly 15,000 cars have been delivered so far.The brand's sales chief, Sven Schuwirth, said CUPRA aims to sell 100,000 Raval units next year. If it reaches that target, the electric hatchback will become the company's best-selling model.CUPRA also reported more than 250,000 deliveries between January and September, an increase of 2% compared with the same period last year.Demand for battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) grew much faster. Orders for these models increased by 79% to more than 108,000. Nearly half of all orders received in the third quarter were for fully electric vehicles.The planned features include an illuminated logo, indicators that project onto the ground and a top speed of up to 190 km/h. The car will also get a reversing assist feature that can retrace up to 50 metres of its previous forward path.CUPRA also presented its new Formula E car for the 2026/27 season. The car, powered by Porsche technology, marks the team's entry into the championship's GEN4 era. The new generation of Formula E cars can reach speeds of more than 335 km/h and accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in less than two seconds. They also feature permanent all-wheel drive.The car retains the team's signature copper colour scheme.ID@undefined Caption not available.British driver Jake Hughes will join the team for the new season. He brings experience from Formula E, including two podium finishes and four pole positions.Pepe Martí will continue for a second season. He was the highest-placed rookie in the previous season and secured podium finishes in Monaco and Sanya.CUPRA also used the event to showcase new in-car audio technology. The Tavascan Black Edition features the SENNHEISER AMBEO Immersive Sound System. Four actuators positioned along the roofline add a height effect to create a 360-degree audio experience. The updated Formentor and Terramar models will also receive the same system. Meanwhile, the Leon and Leon Sportstourer will offer the IMMERSIVE BY SENNHEISER audio system.Also read: Taylor Barnard joins Fortescue Zero Racing for Formula E's GEN4 era in 2026/27

Article Title: Jaguar unveils Type 01 electric car with 1,030PS power and 450-mile range
Article Text:
Jaguar Type 01

Jaguar Type 01 revealed: 0-62mph in 3.2 seconds, 450-mile range and luxury cabin

A modern cabin with new technology

Jaguar on Friday unveiled the Type 01, an all-electric luxury car that marks a new beginning for the British carmaker. Revealed in New York City, the four-door grand tourer combines high performance with modern design and new technology. One of the car's biggest highlights is its acceleration. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque.The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. It comes with a 118kWh usable battery pack and offers a claimed range of up to 400 miles under US EPA testing. Its range is up to 450 miles (720km) under WLTP testing.The car uses an 850-volt electrical system that supports fast charging. When connected to a 350kW DC fast charger, it can add 200 miles of range in just 13 minutes.ID@undefined Caption not available.Built on Jaguar's new Electric Architecture (JEA), the Type 01 has been designed to offer a balance of performance and comfort. Its design includes a low roof, a long bonnet, a short front overhang and large 23-inch wheels. The car also has a 50:50 weight distribution, which is aimed at improving handling.Jaguar has also added intelligent torque vectoring and active aerodynamics to improve performance. These features include movable air vents and a rear spoiler that can extend in three stages. The car has a drag coefficient of 0.23, helping it move through the air more efficiently.The Type 01 has a cabin designed around luxury and technology. A central section divides the interior into four separate areas.The cabin features brass-effect aluminium trim, a 24-inch OLED driver display made from a single piece of glass and a separate 7-inch touchscreen. It also gets a full-width panoramic soundbar and seats with audio features designed to improve the listening experience.Jaguar says the name Type 01 reflects both its history and its future. The word "Type" pays tribute to famous models from the brand's past. The number "0" represents zero emissions, while "1" marks the first car of its new generation.The car also benefits from technology developed through Jaguar TCS Racing's Formula E programme, which has won two world championships.The Type 01 can accelerate from 62 mph to 112 mph (100km/h to 180km/h) in just 4.0 seconds.Designed, engineered and manufactured in the UK, the Type 01 is an important part of Jaguar's move towards becoming a fully electric luxury car brand. Article Title: Formula E names COMSOL its Official Multiphysics Partner in new multi-year deal
Article Text:
Formula E and Comsol

Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology

AI and digital twins also in focus

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

GEN4 to bring bigger technology demands

Formula E on Thursday announced a new multi-year partnership with COMSOL, which will become the Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. The partnership brings together Formula E, the world's leading all-electric motorsport championship, and COMSOL, a company known for its multiphysics simulation and computer-aided engineering software. As part of the partnership, Formula E and COMSOL engineers will use COMSOL Multiphysics to study complex engineering problems involving several physical systems working together.Electric race cars depend on several systems at the same time. These include electrical, thermal, structural, electromagnetic, fluid and battery systems.All these systems have to work together under tough performance and energy limits. COMSOL will provide Formula E's technology teams with simulation software and technical expertise to help them understand how these different physical effects interact.ID@undefined Caption not available.The partnership will also look at simulation apps and digital twin technology. The aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process.Bjorn Sjodin, SVP of Product Management at COMSOL, said, “Formula E is a great example of why multiphysics simulation matters, as multiple phenomena are at play and constantly interact with one another.We are excited to work directly with Formula E's technology team and put COMSOL Multiphysics to work on these kinds of real-world challenges.”Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier said the partnership will strengthen the championship's engineering capabilities.“Technology is at the heart of Formula E, so partnering with COMSOL makes real sense for us and truly enhances our engineering skillsets. COMSOL gives us a powerful environment for understanding complex systems where many different physical effects are connected, but the opportunity goes beyond individual simulations. We're particularly interested in how AI-assisted modelling, agentic workflows, and digital twins can help engineers interact with models, explore designs, and make simulation insight more accessible as we continue to push the limits of electric racing,” he said.The partnership comes as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.The GEN4 era will bring greater demands in areas such as speed, efficiency, energy management and vehicle development. It will introduce what Formula E describes as its fastest and most technologically advanced race car so far.COMSOL has also announced COMSOL Multiphysics version 2027, which is scheduled to arrive later this autumn.The new version will include features aimed at advanced engineering work, including dedicated electric motor modelling, system-level simulation, agentic modelling and wider access to tools for creating simulation apps.The partnership was announced at the COMSOL Conference 2026 Boston. Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier also delivered a keynote speech at the event, discussing the technology and engineering that could shape the future of Formula E.
Article Summary: Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology. Aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process. AI and digital twins also in focus as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.
